name: Nagaland State Data Center (NSDC)
developer: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Government of Nagaland
notes: Government DITC project page describes the Nagaland State Data Centre as the centralized IT infrastructure hub for hosting government applications and enabling secure digital service delivery; architect portfolio places the Nagaland State Data Centre at Kohima and lists an area of 2,500 sq ft with IBM as client, but no MW capacity was found.

name: State Data Center under National Hydrology Project
developer: Water Resources Department, Government of Nagaland
notes: Official DIPR Nagaland release says the Chief Minister inaugurated the State Data Center constructed under the National Hydrology Project on 17 February 2021 at the Chief Engineer's Office, Water Resources Department, Kohima; it serves as a hub for real-time and long-term water resources data management and operational control.

name: PM Gati Shakti Data Centre, Kohima
developer: Government of Nagaland / PM Gati Shakti program
notes: Morung Express reported that under the FY 2022-23 Special Assistance Scheme for States Part-II, funds were disbursed for five Nagaland projects including a PM Gati Shakti Data Centre in Kohima; no capacity or later completion source was found.
